messages:
jordan: Quick planning thread for external pen-test next week. Needs: RBAC ephemeral roles, audit export snapshot, KMS proxy decrypt flow, and retest booking. Can we confirm a 2h ops window?
rachel: Propose Wed 09:00-11:00 PT. Gives us a day to triage before EOW.
jordan: Wed 09-11 PT works. Constraints: no long-lived creds, all decrypts must go through proxy, CloudTrail export immutable during window.
sam: On KMS proxy: we'll only allow Decrypt for objects tagged evidence=true and log key-id+caller+ciphertext id. No DescribeKey.
rachel: Good. Also require MFA and source IP = jumpbox for assessor sessions. Session TTL max 3600s.
jordan: For audit, snapshot CloudTrail and S3 inventory, write manifests to sealed-bucket with object lock 30d. Generate presigned GETs TTL=12h for assessor.
devops-bot: Reminder: intake form stamped. Assessor start 2026-03-27. Use this channel for assessor comms.
sam: Remediation process: each vuln gets ticket with fields: vuln-id, severity, owner, mitigation, evidence links, requested retest window. Template ready.
rachel: Retest windows: quick-fix slot within 72h for high/critical; full regression slot at 14 days. Communicate SLAs to PO.
jordan: Action items:
- sam: implement proxy filter + presign generator (due: EOD today)
- rachel: prepare audit snapshot/runbook + object lock steps (due: tomorrow morning)
- jordan: notify assessor and confirm retest slots (due: today)
devops-bot: Scheduled CI check: block IAM policy changes during window unless emergency, will alert #eng-oncall.
sam: I'll open a PR for the IAM policy and presign script and tag sec-review.
rachel: If anything blocks, escalate to SOC ops. I'll post the final runbook here once PRs are green.
